Brainripper

Biography

Brainripper is a Wormface who recognises Kir as a Joon and invokes an ancient agreement between their peoples. Access to the depths and further information depend on tasks involving a necromancer and the Priest of Silence. His conversations give Kir a link to history that Suslanger’s human authorities do not provide. [1, 2, 3, 4]
